quote: We evaluate our method on 6 datasets spanning a variety of domains. For general-domain tasks, we use CommonsenseQA and SciQ for natural language understanding, as well as QNLI and MNLI for natural language inference. To assess question-answering performance in specialized domains, we include MedMCQA from the medical domain and Law from the legal domain.

Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated a remarkable capacity to internalize and utilize novel information solely from contextual input, without requiring any parameter updates. This ability, referred to as in-context learning (ICL), enables LLMs to leverage a small set of input-output demonstrations to solve previously unseen tasks or adapt to new domains.
outputs: Generated answers for question answering tasks
The outputs are generated answers to questions in multiple-choice format, such as selecting the correct option (A), (B), etc., based on in-context demonstrations.
